description.text: Program Description This subject is a new subject in which advanced molecular biology techniques such as DNA recombination, molecular cloning and biochemistry are used to study biochemical drugs and biological products. It was developed on the basis of pharmacy, pharmaceutical engineering, bioengineering and biotechnology. The subject involves two aspects: one is the microbial medicine, main research produced by microbial metabolism related questions of all kinds of drugs, including breeding, metabolic regulation, isolation, purification, physiological active substances of screening, such as antibiotics,; Second, biochemistry, the main research of the composition and metabolism of the organism to produce drug related issues, including the extraction and separation of the drug, the curative effect of drugs, structure-activity relationship studies of drugs and biological drugs (antibodies, peptides, growth factors and enzyme, etc.) production and preparation process of research. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Microbial and Biochemical Pharmacy at Dalian Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5694 USD/per year ￥ 41000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of the passport The passport must have an expiry date after September of the year you apply, if the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applican 3. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.4. Photocopy of Physical Examination Record. Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirements of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2023. The original piece is required during registration. 5. Self-introduction video Applicants are required to upload a video of self-introduction within one minute, and those who have HSK certificates must use Chinese to introduce themselves. 6.Original or copy document of the highest diploma (afternotarization). If the applicant is currently a student, the pre-graduation certificate issued by the school is required. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 7.Original or copy document of the mark sheet Stamped Transcript from the undergraduate/master program or notarized Chinese/English-translated transcript. Those transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the attending university's academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. 8.Recommendation letters of 2 professors or associate professors The signature date shall be after October 1, 2023. 9.Study Plan of no less than 1000 words. Please clarify your research background, method, content, significance, etc. 10.CV letter 11.Valid HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs(or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.) 12.published essays, or any other supporting materials. 13.family financial proof certificate (or one year bank statement) 14.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.

requirements.text: The applicant must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, should be between 20-35 years old, healthy, has obtained bachelor degree with good marks, has solid financial support to afford the study and living expenses in China.
